_notes: Isometric view settings (display only, never game rules). iso_y_scale squashes the map vertically to fake a tilted camera (1.0 = top-down). hex_size is centre-to-corner in world pixels. A tile's top face is raised by terrain elevation x height_unit; every tile also gets a slab of base_thickness so flat ground still shows an edge. wall_shade_left/right darken the two visible side walls.
